Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The MS proteomics experiment specifically analyzes the interactome of GFP-tagged integrins using GFP-TRAP immunoprecipitation. While the paper describes numerous pharmacological inhibitors (BOP, BIO1211, etc.) and siRNA knockdowns, these were used for phenotypic assays (migration, proliferation) and Western blots, not for the LC-MS/MS dataset (PXD027944), which focused on the identification of binding partners for the overexpressed GFP-tagged proteins.
